★ 25-Year Milestone Celebration ★
Boston College Alum • September 23, 2026

Congratulations on 25 Years, Tim!

Reaching a quarter-century with Accenture is an extraordinary milestone, and I wanted to make sure I reached out to celebrate you today. Across forty years spanning my military career and the corporate world, leaders of your caliber and character are exceedingly rare—firmly at the top of anyone I have ever had the privilege to work with.

You never dictated; you led with genuine inquiry, natural collaboration, and a quiet confidence that always supported and elevated your team. While I can't be there in person tomorrow to raise a glass with you, I wanted to send my deepest respect and congratulations. Wishing you continued fulfillment, good health, and many great rounds ahead.

"Ever to Excel — Honoring 25 years of steadfast leadership, collaboration, and integrity." — Boston College Motto & Tribute
With highest respect and warmest regards,
Michael Jackson
